dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about Nod-Krai...

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: Hehe, a land that holds countless ancient secrets is perfect for us adventurers. Isn't it wonderful?

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: May your adventures be fruitful, just like those of everyone else who sets foot on this land.
